name: Junk Theme Masonry Photo Gallery
author: junkthemedotcom

sections.description:
Junk Theme Masonry Photo Gallery lets you create photo galleries in the WordPress admin and display them anywhere with a shortcode.

Create your own named photo categories on the gallery edit screen and choose Media Library images for each category. Category names can be displayed as filter buttons on the frontend so visitors can view all photos or filter by category.

Features:

  • Masonry and grid layouts.
  • Adjustable desktop columns, image spacing, corner radius, and grid aspect ratio.
  • Custom category filter label, alignment, colors, button shape, text size, and spacing.
  • Optional lightbox with captions, navigation arrows, and keyboard navigation.
  • Optional image entrance and category-switch animations, with reduced-motion support.
  • Optional lazy loading and minified frontend CSS and JavaScript assets.
  • Gallery settings are saved per gallery.
  • No WordPress taxonomy setup is needed for photo categories.

Whether you’re building a photography portfolio, business website, creative agency portfolio, or image-rich website, Junk Gallery Pro gives you the tools to make every gallery stand out.

Usage

Use the shortcode shown in the gallery editor:

[rmg_gallery id="123"]

Replace 123 with the ID of your published gallery. The shortcode uses the settings saved on that gallery.

You can optionally override the saved desktop column count for a specific shortcode:

[rmg_gallery id="123" columns="4"]

The columns attribute accepts values from 1 to 6. Responsive layouts reduce the number of columns on smaller screens.

Settings

All options are available on the gallery edit screen:

  • Layout Settings: Select Masonry or Grid, choose desktop columns and image spacing, set corner radius, and optionally select an aspect ratio for Grid layout. Masonry uses image proportions and does not apply the aspect ratio setting.
  • Filter and Button Styling: Show or hide category filters, set the label for the all-photos button, align the buttons, and customize active and inactive colors, corner radius, text size, padding, and spacing.
  • Animation and Performance: Choose an entrance animation, a category-switch animation, enable or disable lazy loading, and enable Speed Up to use the included minified frontend assets.
  • Lightbox Settings: Enable or disable the lightbox and configure captions, navigation arrows, and keyboard navigation.

Included Files

  • junk-theme-masonry-photo-gallery.php — plugin bootstrap, gallery post type, editor controls, settings, and shortcode output.
  • assets/css/admin.css — styles for gallery editor controls.
  • assets/js/admin.js — media selection, settings interactions, and shortcode copy button.
  • assets/css/gallery.css and assets/js/gallery.js — frontend layout, filters, animations, and lightbox behavior.
  • assets/css/gallery.min.css and assets/js/gallery.min.js — minified frontend assets used when Speed Up is enabled.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the junk-theme-masonry-photo-gallery folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin ZIP through the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Photo Galleries > Add New Photo Gallery.
  4. Give the gallery a title, add one or more categories, and choose photos for each category.
  5. Configure the layout, filters, animations, performance, and lightbox options.
  6. Publish the gallery and copy its shortcode from the Gallery Shortcode sidebar box.
  7. Paste the shortcode into a page or post.
sections.faq:
How do I add category filters?

Create categories in the Gallery Categories and Photos panel on the gallery edit screen. Add a category name and select its photos. If Show Category Filters is enabled, those names appear as filter buttons above the gallery.

Where do I find the shortcode?

Publish or save the gallery. The shortcode is displayed in the Gallery Shortcode sidebar box on the edit screen.

Does Masonry crop my photos to an aspect ratio?

No. Masonry preserves each image’s original proportions. The Image Aspect Ratio option applies to Grid layout only.

What does Speed Up do?

When enabled, the plugin loads its included minified gallery CSS and JavaScript files. Lazy loading is a separate option and can be enabled or disabled independently.

Can I show a gallery without a lightbox?

Yes. Set Enable Lightbox to No. Images link directly to their full-size media file.
